'''2007 Dagobah Regionals Jason McDonald LS You Can Either Profit By This...''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jason McDonald]] at [[2007 Dagobah Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|EJP-L-youcaneitherprofitbythis.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
